title: Logic Basics
description: AND/OR/NOT fundamentals: a motor run-permit interlocked with a guard door and an inverted E-Stop.

title: Blinking Alarm (TP)
description: A TP pulse timer wired through a feedback NOT to retrigger itself, flashing BEACON on/off every 500ms while ALARM_ACTIVE is TRUE.

title: Conveyor Start/Stop Interlock
description: START_PB sets an SR latch, STOP_PB or E_STOP (via OR) resets it; CONVEYOR_RUN follows the latch.

title: Batch Counter (CTU)
description: Counts PART_SENSOR pulses with a CTU block; BATCH_FULL goes TRUE once PART_COUNT reaches the preset of 10.

title: Tank Level Hysteresis Control
description: FILL_PUMP_ON turns on below 20% and off above 80% of TANK_LEVEL, using the HYSTERESIS block to avoid pump chatter.

title: PID Temperature Control
description: A PID block drives HEATER_OUTPUT (0-100%) to bring TEMP_PV to TEMP_SETPOINT.

title: Seatbelt Warning Chain
description: CHIME sounds if IGNITION_ON stays TRUE for 5 seconds while SEATBELT_FASTENED is FALSE.

title: Two-Pump Alternation Station
description: Each START_CYCLE pulse advances a mod-2 counter so PUMP1_RUN and PUMP2_RUN alternate across successive cycles.

title: Switch Debounce Circuit
description: RAW_SWITCH must stay TRUE for 50ms before DEBOUNCED follows, filtering out contact bounce.

title: Parking Garage Car Counter
description: CTUD increments on CAR_ENTER and decrements on CAR_EXIT; LOT_FULL lights once capacity (50) is reached.

title: Emergency Stop Chain
description: Any of three E-Stop stations trips a reset-dominant RS latch; PLANT_SAFE_TO_RUN only returns after RESET_ACK and all stops clear.

title: Star-Delta Motor Start Sequence
description: START_PB/STOP_PB latch MAIN_CONTACTOR; STAR_CONTACTOR runs for 3s, then DELTA_CONTACTOR takes over.
